provenance_warning: Some runs report a clean Git parent commit in W&B while their output logs contain code markers absent from that commit. Run IDs and metrics are pinned, but the exact dirty training diff was not captured.

selection_policy.common: Finished runs only; exclude names containing 'redone'; identify model size from architecture; choose the most recently created run when an experimental cell was repeated.
selection_policy.figure_1: For each displayed model and initial batch size, choose the learning rate with the lowest final cosine validation loss, then use the same learning rate for Seesaw.
selection_policy.figure_2: Use the Figure 1 cosine-selected learning rate for the 150M model at batch sizes 256 and 512, then pin all five alpha/beta variants.
selection_policy.figure_3: For each initial batch size, choose the learning rate with the lowest final cosine validation loss, then use it for Fixed LR and Seesaw.
selection_policy.weight_decay: Pin lr=0.003 and configured weight_decay=0.0001, matching the paper.
